purpose: Non-admission discovery from Exa and original-provider pages of seven event geocoding, impact and US infrastructure/event derivatives, including separately versioned LLM-GeoDis v1/v7 and noncommercial GAUL Geo-Disasters; no commercial data use or model input is approved.

entries.name: NASA SEDAC Geocoded Disasters (GDIS) v1.00
entries.spatial_scope: Global geocodable EM-DAT event locations, with variable national and subnational administrative coverage
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 39,953 geocoded locations associated with 9,924 disasters; GADM v3.6 administrative polygons and centroids, generally Admin1 and at best Admin3
entries.note: GDIS adds location geometries to selected EM-DAT events, not measured flood/wind/quake intensity footprints or insured losses. Geometry of an affected administrative unit must not be treated as a physically affected perimeter. EM-DAT/GADM lineage means GDIS is not independent loss observation; country-specific coverage, access registration, source data rights and snapshot checks remain to be reviewed.

entries.name: LLM-GeoDis global EM-DAT event geocoding dataset (2025)
entries.provider: EM-DAT geocoding research / Zenodo (Ronco et al.)
entries.spatial_scope: Global EM-DAT events with reported locality descriptions and GADM/OSM/Wikidata georeferences
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 14,215 events and 17,948 unique geocoded locations; administrative unit geometries, extracted locality evidence and location reliability measures; five compressed dataset parts
entries.note: LLM-assisted geoparsing of EM-DAT text is neither independent event occurrence evidence nor a measured hazard polygon or insurer loss. Some locations are inferred or ambiguous. Preserve original EM-DAT DisNo, algorithm/version, GADM version, uncertainty, provider release and source lineage. About 30 GB expanded scope is documented; no download or license clearance is claimed. Reproducibility code at github.com/em-dat/emdat_geocoding, related Zenodo code record 17544931.

entries.name: Wikimpacts global climate impact database v1.0.final
entries.provider: Bolin Centre / VUB-HYDR and research collaborators
entries.spatial_scope: Global historical disasters represented in selected Wikipedia articles; uneven geographic and disaster-type coverage
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 2,726 event records and 32,343 subnational impact records in SQLite database, with reported damage and impact ranges and event/locality metadata
entries.note: Official final release is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: commercial insurance reuse or redistribution is NOT authorized by public download; preserve a hard commercial-rights blocker. Wikipedia/LLM extraction, event selection, uncertain damage units and estimates prevent use as independent insured-loss truth. Do not confuse the older 2,928-event v1.0 initial release with the revised 2,726-event v1.0.final. No dataset bytes acquired.

entries.name: SeerAI Source Cooperative HIFLD archived infrastructure GeoParquet
entries.provider: SeerAI / Source Cooperative, republishing historical HIFLD collections
entries.spatial_scope: United States; varies strongly by underlying HIFLD collection and original publication vintage
entries.temporal_scope: Archive published 2025 after public HIFLD source portal retirement in August 2025; original layer dates differ
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Individual infrastructure/thematic vector collections re-encoded as per-layer Parquet with dataset inventory and metadata
entries.note: Republisher describes CC BY 4.0 archive rights, but underlying source ownership, exact layer redistribution and source vintages require per-collection clearance. Discontinued original HIFLD portal prevents treating a mirror as independently maintained current data. Sensitive facilities and national-security context require additional screening. Archive attributes are not insured sums or validated occupancy/vulnerability. No source bytes imported.

entries.name: Earth Genome Source Cooperative Storm Events GeoParquet
entries.provider: Earth Genome / Internet of Water Coalition (NOAA NCEI derived)
entries.spatial_scope: United States, selected territories and event-dependent historic coverage
entries.temporal_scope: NOAA Storm Events history from 1950 onward; Source Cooperative distribution first published 2025, update recency must be checked
entries.resolution_or_granularity: More than two million NOAA-derived storm records in approximately 188 MB GeoParquet, including event_id/episode_id, date, reported property and crop damage, and representative Point geometries
entries.note: This is a downstream cleaned/reprojected NOAA NCEI Storm Events derivative, not an independent observed loss dataset. Many point locations are first reported event coordinates or synthetic county/zone centroids and do NOT represent physical storm footprints; some are null. Property and crop damages are reported economic estimates, never observed insured losses. Preserve original NOAA event_id, episode_id and source version, and verify exact release snapshot, freshness, attribution and producer terms before ingest.

entries.name: LLM-GeoDis global EM-DAT event geocoding Zenodo v7 (10 March 2026)
entries.provider: EM-DAT geocoding research / Zenodo (Ronco et al.)
entries.spatial_scope: Global EM-DAT events with reported locality descriptions and GADM/OSM/Wikidata georeferences
entries.temporal_scope: EM-DAT 2000-2024 geocoding; distinct Zenodo release v7 published 2026-03-10
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 14,215 events and 17,948 named locations with GADM, OSM and Wikidata-derived administrative polygons/points; 14 original-record metadata file identities including five large ZIP parts and a GDIS DisNo crosswalk
entries.note: Pinned Zenodo v7 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18935447 (2026-03-10), distinct from existing 2025 v1 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17544932 and concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17544931. Open/CC BY 4.0 at record level does NOT override upstream EM-DAT, GAUL 2015, GADM or OSM conditions. Model use and commercial redistribution remain unreviewed. Record file metadata are not downloaded file bytes or independently verified digests; historic events are administrative location inferences, NOT observed hazard intensity, physical flood footprints or independent insured/economic losses. Join only on source-preserved EM-DAT DisNo with source-release and polygon-vintage provenance, no row-count/TIV inference.

entries.name: Geo-Disasters v1.0.0 (geocoded EM-DAT climate disaster locations)
entries.provider: Teber et al. / Zenodo / GAUL 2015 source geometry
entries.spatial_scope: 207 countries and territories represented among climate-related EM-DAT disasters; boundary geometry from GAUL 2015
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 45,121 geocoded subnational polygons for 9,217 disaster events; GPKG layers, location-level quality flags 1-4 and event-level dissolved administrative polygons; Douglas-Peucker simplified geometry (0.005 degree tolerance)
entries.note: Critical rights split: provider documents non-commercial GAUL 2015 licence for spatial geometries (with attribution) while non-spatial attributes are CC BY 4.0. Do NOT treat an open Zenodo record as commercial spatial reuse authorization. Administrative unit polygons are geocoding proxies rather than actual climate disaster intensity or physical hazard footprints; reported country-level impact is not automatically allocable across polygons. GAUL2015 source vintage differs from GDIS GADM3.6 and EM-DAT 2026 GADM4.1 migration; compare only with explicit boundary/algorithm/quality metadata. No source bytes fetched or admitted.
